cards.description: 提出Steward系统，将自进化边界写入类型系统，通过不变核心（订单算术、风险规则和纪律代理提示）防止自我编辑触及安全底线；在五个月实盘部署与回放实验中验证了风险控制与抗注入能力。
cards.title: 自主投资的多智能体LLM治理式自进化系统：不变核心约束
cards.limitations: 实盘部署仅五个月、102个交易日，样本期较短；回放实验仅针对五天窗口和单一模型对比；2015-2026回测仅评估核心对最大回撤的影响，未覆盖全部策略表现；系统在更广泛市场条件、长期稳定性和不同资产类别下的泛化能力尚未验证。
cards.titleEn: Governed Self-Evolution for Autonomous Investing: A Multi-Agent LLM System with an Invariant Core
cards.limitationsEn: The live deployment covers only five months and 102 trading days; replay experiments are limited to five-day windows and a single-model comparison; the 2015-2026 backtest only assesses the core's effect on maximum drawdown, not overall strategy performance; generalisation to broader market conditions, long-term stability, and different asset classes remains unverified.
cards.whyItMatters: 为基于不可信网络数据的自主投资代理提供了一种可审计、可回放且安全边界不可自我修改的设计范式，有助于在不可逆操作场景中平衡自适应能力与风险控制。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers an auditable, replayable design paradigm for autonomous investment agents operating on untrusted web data, with safety boundaries that cannot be self-modified, helping balance adaptivity and risk control in irreversible-action settings.
cards.summaryEn: The authors present Steward, a multi-agent LLM system that defines self-evolution boundaries via a type system and an uneditable invariant core. In a five-month live deployment (102 trading days, 1,632 LLM calls), the system contained a 24.6% sector drawdown to a 0.3% loss; replay experiments showed the joint design had no significant loss over five days while a single model lost 1.35 points; a 2015-2026 backtest showed the core reduced maximum drawdown under all 50 random entry policies. The authors report that the reflector traced the dominant failure to its root cause and that the gate applied a learning adopted on trigger evenings and not on control evenings.
cards.originalTitle: Governed Self-Evolution for Autonomous Investing: A Multi-Agent LLM System with an Invariant Core
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes Steward, a multi-agent LLM system that encodes the boundary of self-evolution in its type system and protects an invariant core (order arithmetic, risk rules, and discipline-agent prompts) from self-edits; validated through a five-month live deployment and replay experiments for risk control and injection resistance.
keyPointsEn: Steward comprises nine role-specialised agents (four analysts, a portfolio manager, a protected risk manager, etc.) that decide jointly and emit typed reports.
A seven-layer shared memory, assembled by code from the system's own record, provides each decision with position context, market narrative, calibration, and past decisions.

The system improves by review: code grades every trade and forecast nightly and writes grades into memory; each quarter a reflector proposes prompt learnings that a deterministic gate applies reversibly and verifies by replaying recorded inputs.
cards.summary: 作者提出Steward多智能体LLM系统，通过类型系统界定自进化边界，并设置不可编辑的不变核心。五个月实盘（102个交易日、1632次LLM调用）中，系统将24.6%的板块回撤控制为0.3%亏损；回放实验显示联合设计在五天内无显著亏损，而单一模型亏损1.35个百分点；2015-2026回测表明核心可降低所有50种随机入场策略的最大回撤。作者认为反思器能追溯主要失败根因，且确定性门控应用的学习在触发夜晚被采纳，而在对照夜晚未被采纳。
keyPoints: Steward包含九个角色专业化代理（四名分析师、一名组合经理、一名受保护的风险经理等），共同决策并生成类型化报告。
七层共享记忆由代码从系统自身记录组装，为每次决策提供头寸背景、市场叙事、校准和过往决策信息。
系统通过代码每晚评分交易与预测并写入记忆，每季度反思器提出提示学习，经确定性门控可逆应用并回放验证。

cards.description: 提出 CMAS，将元代理架构搜索形式化为带切换成本与风险约束的序贯替换问题，并通过配对影子回放与校准阈值控制晋升风险。
cards.title: 保守式元代理搜索：非平稳下的架构自适应
cards.limitations: 作者明确指出：校准是经验性的，仅涉及作者设计基准上的更新级回放统计量；不保证全效用提升、不保证模拟金丝雀阶段无损害、不保证序列级错误控制。回测无法认证元层面技能。
cards.titleEn: Conservative Meta-Agent Search: Architecture Adaptation under Non-Stationarity
cards.limitationsEn: The authors state: calibration is empirical, concerning an update-level replay statistic on an author-designed benchmark; it guarantees neither full-utility improvement, nor absence of simulated canary-stage harm, nor sequence-level error control. Backtests cannot certify meta-level skill.
cards.whyItMatters: 为自动化代理架构设计在非平稳环境中的安全替换提供了可操作的风险校准框架，并以金融流作为风险敏感测试台验证元层面泛化，但不声称产生 alpha。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Provides an actionable risk-calibration framework for safe replacement in automated agent architecture design under non-stationarity, using financial streams as a risk-sensitive testbed for meta-level generalization without claiming alpha.
cards.summaryEn: The paper formalizes meta-agent architecture search as sequential incumbent replacement with switching costs and hard risk constraints, and introduces Conservative Meta-Agent Search (CMAS). CMAS retrieves archived architectures, proposes typed graph edits, and scores candidates via paired shadow replay; promotion requires an empirically calibrated, variance-penalized simultaneous score above a pre-specified margin, followed by a simulated canary stage. Across 96 financial streams, CMAS reduces normalized mean surrogate dynamic-oracle regret from 0.116 to 0.104 and raises held-out utility from 0.44 to 0.48; it contracts to near-single-agent teams when extra workers add no value.
cards.originalTitle: Conservative Meta-Agent Search: Architecture Adaptation under Non-Stationarity
cards.descriptionEn: Introduces CMAS, formalizing meta-agent architecture search as sequential incumbent replacement with switching costs and risk constraints, using paired shadow replay and calibrated thresholds to control promotion risk.
keyPointsEn: CMAS formalizes meta-agent architecture search as sequential incumbent replacement with switching costs and hard risk constraints; candidates must pass paired shadow replay and a variance-penalized calibrated score to be promoted.
Across 96 financial streams, CMAS reduces normalized mean surrogate dynamic-oracle regret from 0.116 to 0.104 and raises held-out utility from 0.44 to 0.48.

Deployment inference cost is about 6% lower, but search-inclusive token cost is the highest among compared methods; per-update false-promotion rate is 3.4% against a nominal 5% target, and 4.8% in a sealed rerun.
cards.summary: 论文将元代理架构搜索建模为带切换成本和硬风险约束的序贯现任替换问题，并引入保守式元代理搜索（CMAS）。CMAS 通过存档检索、类型化图编辑和配对影子回放评分候选架构，晋升需满足经验校准的方差惩罚同时得分阈值，并经过模拟金丝雀阶段。作者在 96 条金融流上报告，CMAS 将归一化平均替代动态预言遗憾从 0.116 降至 0.104，留出效用从 0.44 升至 0.48；当额外工作者无价值时收缩至近单代理团队。
keyPoints: CMAS 将元代理架构搜索形式化为带切换成本和硬风险约束的序贯现任替换，候选架构需通过配对影子回放与方差惩罚校准评分才能晋升。
在 96 条金融流上，CMAS 将归一化平均替代动态预言遗憾从 0.116 降至 0.104，留出效用从 0.44 升至 0.48。
部署推理成本约低 6%，但搜索包含的 token 成本在比较方法中最高；每次更新的误晋升率为 3.4%（名义目标 5%），密封重跑中为 4.8%。

cards.description: 该研究提出残差感知神经谱容量（ResNSC），通过引入残差更新统计与历史依赖的分配器（ResNSC-DP），解决了原方法对层配置重排序不敏感的问题，并在预训练与剪枝任务中验证了其有效性。
cards.title: 残差感知神经谱容量改进Transformer资源分配
cards.limitations: 证据基于特定模型规模（121M、374M）与数据集（FineWeb-Edu、WikiText-2、LAMBADA），以及LLaMA-7B剪枝实验；认证边界仅针对有限候选集内的数值评分，并非全局最优保证；方法依赖于规格推导的统计参考，其泛化性需进一步验证；配对反转实验揭示了评分盲区，但未提供通用修正方案。
cards.titleEn: Residual-Aware Neural Spectral Capacity Improves Transformer Resource Allocation
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on specific model scales (121M, 374M) and datasets (FineWeb-Edu, WikiText-2, LAMBADA), as well as LLaMA-7B pruning experiments; the certified bounds apply only to numerically evaluated scores within a finite candidate set, not a global optimality guarantee; the method relies on specification-derived statistical references, and its generalizability requires further validation; paired reversal experiments reveal scoring blind spots but do not provide a general fix.
cards.whyItMatters: 为Transformer架构设计提供了一种无需训练即可预测相对性能的启发式方法，尤其适用于训练成本受限的场景；残差感知的改进提升了分配决策对层配置重排序的敏感性，在预训练与剪枝任务中均带来性能收益。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides a training-free heuristic to predict relative performance for Transformer architecture design, especially when training costs limit experimentation; the residual-aware improvement enhances the sensitivity of allocation decisions to compatible reorderings, yielding performance gains in both pretraining and pruning tasks.
cards.summaryEn: Neural Spectral Capacity (NSC) is a heuristic for predicting post-training performance from architectural specifications, but it scores projections independently and is insensitive to compatible reorderings. The authors propose ResNSC, which uses a specification-derived statistical reference of residual updates to determine input and residual-state statistics in each projection's capacity calculation, and extend the allocator to ResNSC-DP, jointly allocating residual and feed-forward widths. In 121M and 374M pretraining and LLaMA-7B pruning experiments, ResNSC-DP achieves lower perplexity or higher average accuracy at comparable parameter budgets; paired reversal experiments show performance differences hidden by position-independent scoring.
cards.originalTitle: Neural Spectral Capacity with Residual Context for Heterogeneous Resource Allocation within Transformers
cards.descriptionEn: This study introduces Residual-Aware Neural Spectral Capacity (ResNSC) with a history-dependent allocator (ResNSC-DP), addressing the insensitivity of the original method to compatible reorderings of layer configurations, and validates its effectiveness in pretraining and pruning tasks.
keyPointsEn: ResNSC introduces a residual-update statistical reference, making capacity computation account for history dependence due to varying residual widths.
ResNSC-DP jointly allocates residual and feed-forward widths under a resource budget and provides certified bounds on the best score within a finite candidate set.
In 121M/374M pretraining, selected architectures achieve lower mean perplexity than uniform, variable-width, and tapered allocations on FineWeb-Edu, WikiText-2, and LAMBADA.
In LLaMA-7B pruning, ResNSC-DP improves eight-task average accuracy over NSC by 3.28–5.46 percentage points across eight matched parameter budgets.
cards.summary: 神经谱容量（NSC）是一种从架构规格预测训练后性能的启发式方法，但独立评分各投影且对兼容重排序不敏感。作者提出ResNSC，利用规格推导的残差更新统计参考确定投影输入与残差状态统计，并扩展分配器为ResNSC-DP，联合分配残差与前馈宽度。在121M与374M预训练及LLaMA-7B剪枝实验中，ResNSC-DP在参数预算相当下取得更低困惑度或更高平均准确率；配对反转实验表明性能差异被位置无关评分掩盖。
keyPoints: ResNSC引入残差更新统计参考，使容量计算考虑残差宽度变化带来的历史依赖。
ResNSC-DP在资源预算下联合分配残差与前馈宽度，并提供有限候选集内最优评分的认证边界。
在121M/374M预训练中，所选架构在FineWeb-Edu、WikiText-2和LAMBADA上平均困惑度低于均匀、可变宽度和锥形分配。
在LLaMA-7B剪枝中，ResNSC-DP在八个匹配参数预算下八任务平均准确率比NSC提升3.28–5.46个百分点。

cards.description: 研究提出专家引导强化学习（EGRL）训练策略，并基于此构建轻量MLP策略DriveMLP；在nuPlan Reactive基准上以86.51分超过此前最佳IL规划器Flow Planner 3.2分，且推理速度提升15倍以上。
cards.title: DriveMLP：训练策略胜过模型复杂度的实证研究
cards.limitations: 证据主要来自nuPlan Val14 Reactive基准上的受控实证研究，结论对其他数据集、城市场景或真实道路的泛化性尚未验证；EGRL依赖日志专家数据构建轨迹距离奖励，其有效性可能受数据分布与质量影响；与Flow Planner的比较限于该基准与实验设置，不宜直接外推为普遍优越性。
cards.titleEn: DriveMLP: Training Strategy Outperforms Model Complexity in Autonomous Driving
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence mainly comes from a controlled empirical study on the nuPlan Val14 Reactive benchmark; generalization to other datasets, urban scenarios, or real roads has not been validated. EGRL relies on logged expert data to construct trajectory-distance rewards, and its effectiveness may be affected by data distribution and quality. The comparison with Flow Planner is limited to this benchmark and experimental setting and should not be directly extrapolated as general superiority.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作提示在自动驾驶运动规划中，改进训练策略可能比单纯增大模型更有效，为开发轻量、高推理效率的规划器提供了可参考的实证路径。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The work suggests that in autonomous driving motion planning, improving the training strategy may be more effective than simply scaling up models, offering an empirically grounded path toward lightweight, inference-efficient planners.
cards.summaryEn: The paper studies a closed-loop imitation learning framework that uses reinforcement learning purely as an optimization tool, guided by a trajectory-distance reward derived from logged expert data, termed Expert-Guided RL (EGRL). Through a controlled empirical study, the authors find that the training procedure, rather than model size and complexity, accounts for a substantial part of the performance gains. They then introduce DriveMLP, a lightweight MLP policy trained with EGRL, achieving 86.51 on the nuPlan Val14 Reactive benchmark, a +3.2 point improvement over the previous best IL planner (Flow Planner), with >15x faster inference.
cards.originalTitle: DriveMLP: When Training Strategy Outperforms Model Complexity in Autonomous Driving
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes Expert-Guided RL (EGRL) as a training strategy and builds DriveMLP, a lightweight MLP policy; it scores 86.51 on the nuPlan Reactive benchmark, outperforming the previous best IL planner Flow Planner by 3.2 points with over 15x faster inference.
keyPointsEn: Proposes EGRL training strategy: uses trajectory-distance reward from expert data and RL purely as an optimization tool to train closed-loop IL policies.
Controlled experiments indicate training strategy contributes more to performance gains than model size and complexity.
DriveMLP, a lightweight MLP, scores 86.51, outperforming Flow Planner by 3.2 points with over 15x faster inference.
cards.summary: 论文研究闭环模仿学习框架，将强化学习仅作为优化工具，用基于专家轨迹距离的奖励引导训练，称为专家引导强化学习（EGRL）。通过受控实验，作者发现训练过程而非模型规模与复杂度贡献了显著性能增益。基于此，他们提出DriveMLP，一个用EGRL训练的轻量级MLP策略，在nuPlan Val14 Reactive基准上取得86.51分，比之前最佳IL规划器Flow Planner高3.2分，推理速度快15倍以上。
keyPoints: 提出EGRL训练策略：以专家轨迹距离为奖励，将RL仅用作优化工具来训练闭环IL策略。
受控实验表明训练策略对性能提升的贡献大于模型规模与复杂度。
DriveMLP以轻量MLP实现86.51分，超Flow Planner 3.2分，推理速度提升15倍以上。

cards.description: 该研究利用某交易所高频数据，将买卖执行匹配为持仓，并把已实现盈亏与期限匹配的预测代理指标及流动性角色相联系，从而在日内层面量化预测能力与流动性供给对机构自营盈利的贡献。
cards.title: 机构交易者日内预测能力与流动性供给的盈利关联
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自单一股票交易所的高频样本，结论外推需谨慎；预测能力与盈亏、流动性供给与盈亏均为回归中的统计关联，不能直接解释为因果关系；假设性跟流策略的夏普比率基于事后匹配的执行流构造，未考虑实际交易成本、市场冲击与容量约束；样本期与市场结构特征可能影响结果。
cards.titleEn: Intraday Forecasting Ability and Liquidity Provision Linked to Institutional Traders' Profitability
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from a single stock exchange's high-frequency sample, so external validity requires caution; the links between forecasting ability and P&L, and between liquidity provision and P&L, are statistical associations in regressions and cannot be directly interpreted as causal; the hypothetical flow-following Sharpe ratios are constructed from ex-post matched execution flows and do not account for actual trading costs, market impact, or capacity constraints; sample period and market structure characteristics may affect results.
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为理解机构交易者日内盈利的来源提供了可操作的分解框架：将盈亏分别与预测能力和流动性供给角色挂钩，有助于评估交易技能与做市行为在自营交易中的相对贡献。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study offers an operational decomposition framework for understanding the sources of institutional traders' intraday profits: by separately linking P&L to forecasting ability and liquidity-provision roles, it helps assess the relative contributions of trading skill and market-making behavior in proprietary trading.
cards.summaryEn: Based on high-frequency exchange data, the study finds persistent intraday forecasting ability among institutional traders, with stronger forecasting ability associated with higher P&L per matched position. The authors also report that within matched positions, more passive executions (greater liquidity-provision intensity) are associated with higher P&L. These are associational findings from the authors' sample and regression specifications, not causal conclusions.
cards.originalTitle: Intraday Forecasting Ability and Liquidity Provision of Institutional Traders
cards.descriptionEn: Using high-frequency data from a stock exchange, the study matches buy and sell executions into positions and links realized P&L to horizon-matched forecasting proxies and the liquidity roles of both executions, thereby quantifying the intraday contributions of forecasting ability and liquidity provision to institutional proprietary profitability.
keyPointsEn: Hypothetical flow-following strategies based on skillful traders' execution flows yield annualized Sharpe ratios ranging from 16 to 63 across trading frequencies.
A one-standard-deviation increase in the forecasting-ability proxy is associated with 1.02–1.19 currency units higher P&L per matched position.
P&L is 1.28–1.31 currency units higher for one passive execution than for none, and a further 3.79–3.82 higher for two than for one.
cards.summary: 研究基于交易所高频数据发现，机构交易者存在持续的日内预测能力，且预测能力越强，匹配持仓的盈亏越高。作者还报告，在匹配持仓内被动执行次数越多（流动性供给强度越高），盈亏也越高。上述结果是作者在其样本与回归设定下得出的关联性证据，并非因果结论。
keyPoints: 基于熟练交易者执行流构造的假设性跟流策略，在不同交易频率下年化夏普比率为16至63。
预测能力代理指标每增加一个标准差，匹配持仓盈亏高1.02至1.19货币单位。
匹配持仓中被动执行次数为一次时，盈亏比零次高1.28至1.31货币单位；两次比一次再高3.79至3.82货币单位。

cards.description: 该研究提出MemPlan框架，将大语言模型（LLM）的角色从长程规划器转变为语言与符号规划之间的受限桥梁，在固定PDDL领域的前提下，利用正负记忆重建问题并引导规划，从而降低在线token成本并提升任务完成效率。
cards.title: MemPlan：记忆条件化PDDL规划应对部分可观测文本环境
cards.limitations: 实验仅在TextWorld、ALFWorld和Robotouille三个文本环境基准上进行，未涉及真实世界或更复杂的多模态场景。PDDL领域保持固定，可能限制对动态领域变化的适应能力。正负记忆机制依赖观察解析和执行反馈的质量，在噪声或稀疏反馈下的表现尚不明确。与ReAct等基线的token成本比较基于特定实验设置，泛化性需进一步验证。
cards.titleEn: MemPlan: Memory-Conditioned PDDL Planning for Partially Observable Text Environments
cards.limitationsEn: Experiments are limited to three text-environment benchmarks: TextWorld, ALFWorld, and Robotouille, without real-world or more complex multimodal scenarios. The PDDL domain is kept fixed, which may limit adaptability to dynamic domain changes. The positive and negative memory mechanisms depend on the quality of observation parsing and execution feedback, and their performance under noisy or sparse feedback remains unclear. The token cost comparison with baselines such as ReAct is based on specific experimental settings and requires further validation for generalizability.
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法提供了一种降低LLM在线规划成本并提升符号规划在部分可观测文本环境中鲁棒性的思路。其统一模式条件语言-符号接口经离线监督微调后，可跨TextWorld任务类型复用而无需任务特定微调，为构建可复用的规划接口提供了参考。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This approach offers a way to reduce LLM online planning costs and improve the robustness of symbolic planning in partially observable text environments. The unified schema-conditioned language-symbol interface, trained offline with supervised fine-tuning, can be reused across TextWorld task types without task-specific fine-tuning, providing a reference for building reusable planning interfaces.
cards.summaryEn: MemPlan is a memory-conditioned PDDL planning framework for partially observable interactive text environments. It keeps the PDDL domain fixed and reconstructs the PDDL problem at each step from parsed observations, candidate hypotheses, and interaction memory, using positive memory to assign action costs and negative memory to compile exclusion constraints. Experiments on TextWorld, ALFWorld, and Robotouille show improved task completion and step efficiency over language-only and PDDL-aware baselines, with substantially reduced online token cost.
cards.originalTitle: MemPlan: Memory-Conditioned PDDL Planning for Partially Observable Text Environments
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes MemPlan, a framework that shifts LLMs from long-horizon planners to constrained bridges between language and symbolic planning, reconstructing PDDL problems with positive and negative memory under a fixed domain to reduce online token cost and improve task completion efficiency.
keyPointsEn: MemPlan positions LLMs as constrained interfaces between language and symbolic planning rather than direct long-horizon planners, mitigating hallucinated or invalid actions.

The framework uses positive graph memory to assign relevance-based action costs to candidate hypotheses for missing objects, locations, or conditions, guiding the planner toward more plausible checks.
Negative memory records assumptions refuted by execution feedback and compiles them into exclusion constraints, preventing repeated attempts at already contradicted candidates.
cards.summary: MemPlan是一个面向部分可观测交互文本环境的记忆条件化PDDL规划框架。它保持PDDL领域固定，每步根据解析的观察、候选假设和交互记忆重建PDDL问题，并用正记忆分配动作成本、负记忆生成排除约束。实验表明，在TextWorld、ALFWorld和Robotouille上，MemPlan相比纯语言和PDDL感知基线提升了任务完成率与步骤效率，并显著降低在线token消耗。
keyPoints: MemPlan将LLM定位为语言到符号规划的受约束接口，而非直接的长程规划器，以缓解幻觉和无效动作问题。
框架通过正图记忆为缺失对象、位置或条件的候选假设分配基于相关性的动作成本，引导规划器优先检查更合理的假设。
负记忆记录被执行反馈否定的假设，并编译为排除约束，避免重复尝试已被证伪的候选。

cards.description: 该研究构建P2NPCBench基准，通过对抗式多智能体重写移除教科书线索，发现模型在NP完全问题上表现显著低于P孪生问题，且加固后差距缩小，表明部分差距源于表述熟悉度而非复杂度类别。
cards.title: 配对P与NP完全问题测试LLM推理边界
cards.limitations: 结论基于12个问题族和12个模型，是否推广到其他复杂度类别或更广泛模型尚不确定；加固后的陈述虽经人工验证，但可能引入其他分布偏差；未评估模型规模或训练数据对类别差距的影响。
cards.titleEn: Testing LLM Reasoning Boundaries with Paired P and NP-Complete Problems
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are based on 12 problem families and 12 models, and generalizability to other complexity classes or broader model sets is uncertain; hardened statements, though human-verified, may introduce other distribution biases; the impact of model scale or training data on the class gap is not assessed.
cards.whyItMatters: 该基准有助于区分模型是在真正推理问题结构，还是依赖对教科书表述的记忆，为评估LLM的推理能力提供了更受控的测试方法。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The benchmark helps distinguish whether models genuinely reason about problem structure or rely on memorized textbook phrasing, offering a more controlled way to evaluate LLM reasoning.
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose P2NPCBench, covering 12 problem families where each NP-complete problem is paired with a surface-identical P twin, and use the AgentGAN framework to remove textbook cues via adversarial rewriting. Evaluating 12 models, they find NP-complete pass@1 is 35.4% versus 63.8% for P twins, and 95.1% of model pairs fail more often on the NP side. The authors argue that hardening narrows the class gap from 24.8 to 14.6 points, indicating that part of the apparent gap reflects familiarity with textbook phrasing rather than complexity class itself.
cards.originalTitle: Did the Problem Actually Get Harder? Testing LLMs on Paired P and NP-Complete Problems Hardened by Adversarial Multi-Agent Rewriting
cards.descriptionEn: The study introduces P2NPCBench, a benchmark that uses adversarial multi-agent rewriting to remove textbook cues, finding that models perform significantly worse on NP-complete problems than on their P twins and that the gap narrows after hardening, suggesting part of the gap reflects familiarity with textbook phrasing rather than complexity class.
keyPointsEn: P2NPCBench contains 2,114 statements hardened by adversarial rewriting, with all rewrites preserving answers and complexity classes.
Across 12 models, average pass@1 is 35.4% on NP-complete problems and 63.8% on P twins.
A tenfold increase in time limit raises NP-complete accuracy only from 28.5% to 31.9%, indicating failures stem from wrong or crashing programs rather than speed.
cards.summary: 作者提出P2NPCBench，包含12个问题族，每个NP完全问题与一个表面相同的P孪生问题配对，并使用AgentGAN框架通过对抗重写移除教科书线索。评估12个模型发现，NP完全问题pass@1为35.4%，低于P孪生问题的63.8%，且95.1%的模型对在NP侧失败更多。作者认为，加固后类别差距从24.8缩小到14.6点，说明部分表观差距反映的是对教科书措辞的熟悉度而非复杂度类别本身。
keyPoints: P2NPCBench包含2,114条经过对抗重写加固的陈述，所有重写保持答案和复杂度类别不变。
12个模型在NP完全问题上平均pass@1为35.4%，在P孪生问题上为63.8%。
将时间限制提高十倍，NP完全问题准确率仅从28.5%升至31.9%，失败主因是错误或崩溃程序而非速度。

cards.description: 该研究指出，既有文献在评估实时电价下家庭电池对配电网峰值的影响时，通常把批发电价视为外生变量，忽略了电池集体响应价格信号本身会推高批发价、进而抑制充电激励的反馈机制。作者用校准至2025年德国数据的均衡批发电价模型进行模拟，发现计入价格反馈后，同步充电造成的配电网协同进口峰值由无电池基准之上83%变为基准之下6%，风险评估显著小于既有文献。
cards.title: 价格内生性改变家庭电池同步充电的配电网峰值评估
cards.limitations: 证据来自基于德国2025年数据校准的模拟模型，而非实测部署数据；结论依赖所设定的零售电价机制（基于现货的零售电价）、均衡价格模型及情景与年份设定，作者仅称其在上述变体中稳健；研究讨论的是协同进口峰值这一指标，不能直接外推至其他电网指标、其他市场设计或其他国家；电池渗透率快于全国平均的电网仍可能出现新本地峰值，模型未给出此类情形的定量边界。
cards.titleEn: Price Endogeneity Reshapes Estimated Distribution Grid Peaks from Synchronized Home Battery Charging
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from a simulation model calibrated to German 2025 data rather than measured deployment data; conclusions depend on the assumed spot-based retail tariff, the equilibrium price model, and the scenario and year settings, with robustness claimed only across those variations; the study addresses the coincident import peak metric and does not directly generalize to other grid metrics, market designs, or countries; new local peaks remain possible in grids where battery penetration runs ahead of the national average, and the model does not quantify bounds for such cases.
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究提示，评估分布式电池对配电网的影响时若忽略价格反馈，可能高估本地峰值并误导电网加固与灵活性政策设计；对量化研究而言，它说明均衡建模假设会实质性改变结论方向，而非仅影响数值大小。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study suggests that ignoring price feedback when assessing distributed batteries' grid impacts may overstate local peaks and misguide grid reinforcement and flexibility policy; for quantitative research, it shows that equilibrium modeling assumptions can change the direction of conclusions, not just their magnitude.
cards.summaryEn: Facts: under exogenous prices, the simulation reproduces prior findings, with synchronized home battery charging pushing the local grid's coincident import peak 83% above its no-battery level; with endogenous prices, the same fleet leaves that peak 6% below the no-battery benchmark. Author's view: treating prices as non-responsive systematically overstates local peak risk, because charging concentrated in low-price hours raises wholesale prices and spreads charging across hours in equilibrium; real risk and magnitude are therefore smaller than prior literature indicates, though new local peaks remain possible, especially in grids where battery deployment runs ahead of the national average.
cards.originalTitle: The missing price feedback: Why studies overstate local grid peaks from synchronized home batteries under real-time pricing
cards.descriptionEn: Prior studies assessing how home batteries under real-time pricing affect distribution grids typically treat wholesale prices as exogenous, ignoring that collective battery response itself raises wholesale prices and dampens the charging incentive. Using an equilibrium wholesale-price model calibrated to 2025 German data, the author finds that accounting for this price feedback turns a coincident import peak 83% above the no-battery benchmark into one 6% below it, implying ma
keyPointsEn: The coincident import peak differs by roughly half the benchmark between exogenous and endogenous price settings: 83% above versus 6% below the no-battery level
The result is robust across alternative price functions, exogenous price paths, different peak measures, 20 scenario variations, and three historical years
The author highlights price feedback as the key mechanism: charging in low-price hours raises wholesale prices, weakening synchronized charging incentives and spreading charging in equilibrium
cards.summary: 事实：在价格外生假设下，模拟复现了既有文献的结论，即家庭电池同步充电使本地电网协同进口峰值比无电池情形高83%；改用内生价格后，同一电池车队使该峰值比无电池基准低6%。作者观点：价格被视为不响应会系统性高估本地峰值风险，因为低价时段集中充电会抬升批发价并分散充电时段；因此真实风险与幅度小于既有文献所述，但新本地峰值仍可能出现，尤其是在电池渗透率快于全国平均的电网。
keyPoints: 价格外生与内生两种设定下，同一电池车队的协同进口峰值结果相差约半个基准：前者高出83%，后者低6%
结论在替代价格函数、外生价格路径、不同峰值度量、20种情景变体与三个历史年份中均保持稳健
作者强调价格反馈是关键机制：低价时段充电推高批发价，从而削弱同步充电激励并使充电在均衡中分散

cards.description: 该研究提出基于模拟推断的框架，学习粗糙Heston模型参数在隐含波动率曲面条件下的后验分布，并将后验不确定性通过异方差神经代理定价器传播到路径依赖奇异期权的价格区间；同时引入Hellinger-SHAP信息论可解释性方法，识别后验信息增益对应的期限-行权价区域。其新意在于将后验不确定性与可解释性结合，为神经网络校准和奇异期权定价提供透明框架。
cards.title: 粗糙波动率深度学习中的不确定性与可解释性：神经信息论后验方法
cards.limitations: 证据基于模拟研究，覆盖前瞻启动、障碍和已实现方差类合约，结论依赖于指定的先验预测模型与神经代理定价器设置；后验预测区间的校准或保守性尚未在真实市场数据上验证，点代入价格不可靠性的具体合约条件也需进一步检验。
cards.titleEn: Uncertainty and Explainability in Deep Rough Volatility: A Neural Information-Theoretic Posterior Approach
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence is based on a simulation study covering forward-start, barrier, and realized-variance claims, and conclusions depend on the specified prior-predictive model and neural surrogate pricer settings. The calibration or conservativeness of posterior-predictive intervals has not been validated on real market data, and the specific contract regimes where point plug-in prices are materially unreliable require further examination.
cards.whyItMatters: 传统神经网络点校准无法刻画观测隐含波动率曲面后剩余的参数不确定性；该框架将后验不确定性纳入奇异期权定价区间，并借助信息论可解释性方法揭示后验信息在期限-行权价上的来源，有助于提升模型校准与定价的透明度。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Neural point calibration alone does not capture the parameter uncertainty remaining after an implied-volatility surface is observed; this framework incorporates posterior uncertainty into exotic option price intervals and uses an information-theoretic explainability method to reveal where posterior information gains arise across maturity and moneyness, enhancing transparency in model calibration and pricing.
cards.summaryEn: The authors develop a simulation-based inference framework for rough Heston calibration that uses neural ratio estimation to obtain posterior samples of model parameters conditional on an implied-volatility surface, and propagates these through neural surrogate pricers to produce posterior-predictive distributions for path-dependent exotic options. In a simulation study, posterior-predictive intervals provide calibrated or conservative coverage across forward-start, barrier, and realized-variance claims, while point plug-in prices can be materially unreliable for selected contract regimes. The authors further introduce Hellinger-SHAP, applying local-background Kernel SHAP to a posterior-information functional to identify maturity-moneyness regions associated with posterior information gain for individual rHeston parameters. These are reported findings; the authors' view that the framework offers transparent uncertainty-aware calibration and pricing analysis is an opinion.
cards.originalTitle: Uncertainty and Explainability in Deep Rough Volatility: A Neural Information-Theoretic Posterior Approach
cards.descriptionEn: The study develops a simulation-based inference framework that learns the posterior distribution of rough Heston parameters conditional on an implied-volatility surface and propagates posterior uncertainty through heteroscedastic neural surrogate pricers to obtain uncertainty-aware price intervals for path-dependent exotic options. It also introduces Hellinger-SHAP, an information-theoretic explainability method that identifies maturity-moneyness regions associated with poste
keyPointsEn: A simulation-based inference framework using neural ratio estimation learns the posterior distribution of rough Heston parameters conditional on an implied-volatility surface.
Posterior parameter uncertainty is propagated through heteroscedastic neural surrogate pricers to generate posterior-predictive price intervals for path-dependent exotic options.
Hellinger-SHAP applies local-background Kernel SHAP to a posterior-information functional, identifying maturity-moneyness regions associated with posterior information gain for each parameter.
cards.summary: 作者开发了面向粗糙Heston校准的模拟推断框架，利用神经比率估计获得参数后验样本，并通过神经代理定价器将后验预测分布用于路径依赖奇异期权的定价区间。模拟研究表明，后验预测区间在前瞻启动、障碍和已实现方差类合约上提供校准或保守覆盖，而点代入价格在部分合约条件下可能严重不可靠。作者进一步提出Hellinger-SHAP，将局部背景Kernel SHAP应用于后验信息泛函，以识别与单个参数后验信息增益相关的期限-行权价区域。以上为论文报告的事实；作者认为该框架能提供透明的不确定性感知校准与定价分析，属于作者观点。
keyPoints: 提出基于神经比率估计的模拟推断框架，学习粗糙Heston模型参数在隐含波动率曲面下的后验分布。
将后验参数不确定性通过异方差神经代理定价器传播，生成路径依赖奇异期权的后验预测价格区间。
引入Hellinger-SHAP，对后验信息泛函应用局部背景Kernel SHAP，识别各参数后验信息增益对应的期限-行权价区域。

cards.whyItMatters: 为紫微斗数数字化提供了一套特定流派的参考实现，有助于传统命理知识的整理与工具化，但仅适合文化研究与技术学习，不构成任何预测或决策依据。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a reference implementation of a specific lineage for digitizing Zi Wei Dou Shu, which can assist in organizing and tooling traditional astrological knowledge, but it is suitable only for cultural research and technical learning, not as a basis for prediction or decision-making.
cards.summaryEn: The GitHub project ziwei-doushu provides a Zi Wei Dou Shu charting engine based on Ni Haixia's Tian Ji system, including complete charting algorithms, the Four Transformations system, a pattern knowledge base, and classical text data. It is open-source code intended to replicate the charting logic of a specific lineage. Note that the accuracy of its algorithms and data has not been independently verified, and Zi Wei Dou Shu is a traditional divination practice without scientifically proven predictive validity.
cards.descriptionEn: New in that it openly implements the Zi Wei Dou Shu charting system of Ni Haixia's Tian Ji lineage, including complete algorithms, the Four Transformations system, a pattern knowledge base, and classical text data; useful for researchers and developers in traditional astrology.

cards.description: 这是Quantocracy于2026年10月22日汇总的量化研究链接清单，核心条目介绍用变化率（ROC）对动量进行择时，并以标普500历史上十条最陡趋势为分析对象。它的用处是提示研究者关注动量信号与趋势强度度量之间可能存在的条件关系，并提供可进一步查阅的原始文章入口。

cards.summaryEn: The item is a periodic link roundup from the quant blog aggregator Quantocracy, dated October 22, 2026. As a matter of fact, one listed link discusses timing momentum using rate of change (ROC) applied to the S&P 500's ten steepest trends, and momentum is described as one of the oldest trading ideas.
